cards.ex: Hold on a second, let me check my calendar.
I asked for a refund. → He ignored my message. (get a refund, ignore a message/call)
Take an umbrella, just in case.
I avoid driving at rush hour. → Can you fix the printer? (avoid + -ing, fix a problem)

quiz.note: Hold on a second = 잠깐만요. 전화·대화 중에 정말 자주 쓰는 한마디!

quiz.q: The shirt didn't fit, so I got a ___ .
quiz.note: get a refund = 환불받다. 가게에서 Can I get a refund? 로 바로 써 보세요.
just in case = 혹시 모르니까. 문장 끝에 붙이면 끝!

quiz.q: Try to ___ eating late at night.
quiz.note: avoid + -ing = ~하는 것을 피하다. avoid to eat ❌ / avoid eating ⭕

quiz.q: Do you like the new office? — ___ . It's a bit far.
quiz.note: Kind of = 약간/좀. Yes나 No로 딱 잘라 말하기 애매할 때 딱이에요.

cards.ex: I'm not sure what time we'll finish — let's play it by ear.
He was reluctant to sign. → I convinced him to join. (reluctant to V, convince 사람 to V)
I'll check and get back to you by Friday.
We resolved the issue quickly. → Don't neglect your health. (resolve an issue, neglect a duty)
The bottom line is we need more time.

quiz.q: We don't have a plan for Saturday — let's just ___ .
quiz.note: play it by ear = 상황 봐서 하자. 계획 없이 유연하게 갈 때!

quiz.q: She was ___ to share her opinion in the meeting.
quiz.note: be reluctant to V = ~하기를 꺼리다. 반대는 be eager to V.

quiz.q: I don't have the numbers now. I'll ___ you this afternoon.
quiz.note: get back to 사람 = 다시 연락 주다. 전치사 to 꼭 챙기세요.

quiz.q: It took weeks to ___ the complaint.
quiz.note: resolve an issue/complaint = 해결하다. 명사형은 resolution.

quiz.q: ___ is that the project is over budget.
quiz.note: The bottom line is ~ = 결론은 ~이다. 회의 마무리 멘트로 최고!

cards.ex: The new hire hit the ground running on her first day.
The instructions were ambiguous. → Is this plan feasible? (ambiguous ↔ clear, feasible ↔ unrealistic)
The client rejected the design, so we're back to square one.
She is meticulous about details. → The auditors scrutinized every receipt. (meticulous about N, scrutinize N)
I didn't want to steal her thunder, so I waited to announce my news.

quiz.q: We onboarded him fast so he could ___ .
quiz.note: hit the ground running = 적응 기간 없이 바로 본격적으로. 신입·새 프로젝트 얘기에 자주 등장.

quiz.q: The contract wording is ___ — it could mean two things.
quiz.note: ambiguous = 두 가지 이상으로 해석되는. 명사형 ambiguity.

quiz.q: The merger fell through, so we're ___ .
quiz.note: back to square one = 원점. 보드게임 첫 칸에서 온 표현.

quiz.q: Is it ___ to finish by Friday with only two people?
quiz.note: feasible = 현실적으로 가능한. feasibility study(타당성 조사)로도 많이 써요.

quiz.q: She announced the launch before I could — she totally ___ .
quiz.note: steal someone's thunder = 주목받을 기회를 가로채다. 과거형 stole!
